plans.sql:
SELECT r.id,r.status,h.revision,p.snapshot_json,t.supported_features_json,
    (SELECT json_group_array(json_object(
      'feature_key',f.feature_key,'allowed',f.allowed,'manager_editable',f.manager_editable,
      'forced_value',f.forced_value,'revision',f.revision,'policy_revision',s.revision))
      FROM feature_policies f) policy_json
    FROM restaurants r
    JOIN restaurant_publication_heads h ON h.restaurant_id=r.id
    JOIN restaurant_publications p ON p.restaurant_id=h.restaurant_id AND p.revision=h.revision
    LEFT JOIN platform_policy_state s ON s.singleton=1
    LEFT JOIN template_releases t ON t.template_id=json_extract(p.snapshot_json,?)
      AND t.version=json_extract(p.snapshot_json,?)
    WHERE r.slug=? AND r.status='active'

SEARCH s USING INTEGER PRIMARY KEY (rowid=?) LEFT-JOIN
SEARCH t USING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_template_releases_1 (template_id=? AND version=?) LEFT-JOIN

remote.scope: Single client/region, 10-second arrival windows, at most 100 simultaneous read-only HTTP requests. Retained tiny synthetic publication; no browser execution, guest writes, login, upload or multi-region certification. Gate is a provisional engineering budget.

health_control.scope: Same load generator and staging host, environment-check query only; no menu projection or R2.
